description: This file defines the LowOrderFee class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It extends a Model class from the system engine and contains a method getTotal that calculates and adds a low order fee to the order totals if certain conditions are met. The class is part of the Extension/Opencart/Total namespace, indicating its role in order total calculations.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: Represents a model for calculating low order fees in the order total extension of OpenCart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the low order fee to the order totals if the subtotal is below a configured threshold, also handles tax calculations for the fee.
